forge.book_no_hammer: Pretty book. Useless in your hands. And in mine, with this hammer.
forge.book_wont: It won't take what's in that book.
forge.half: That's better than this hammer leaves it.
forge.leave_half: Leave it with me tonight. Halfway is the best this hammer does.
forge.no_hammer: Not till I've a hammer for it.
forge.not_mine: That's not mine to make again. Hold it out with nothing in your other hand, and I'll mend it.
forge.room: Make room. I'll not drop it in the mud.
forge.whole: It's whole. Nothing for me to do.

lines.text: Iron's good. But the Frost Walkers had a metal that laughed at the cold. I've never seen it worked.
Wool keeps you alive. The Frost Walkers walked on snow as if it were a road. They made shoes for it.
Leaves keep the sun off. The Sand Singers live where nothing else can. Ask one how, if you ever meet one.
